name: Music Release
description: Coordinate a music release from masters and metadata through rights, distribution, assets, launch calendar, promotion, and post-release review.

tasks.name: Lock release inventory
tasks.objective: Confirm tracks, versions, sequence, masters, instrumental/clean edits, artwork, credits, lyrics, contributors, splits, samples, clearances, territory restrictions, and release date.

tasks.name: Prepare metadata and rights package
tasks.objective: Verify artist/title formatting, writers, producers, performers, labels, copyright lines, explicit flags, ISRC/UPC or requested identifiers, publishing information, and platform-specific metadata.

tasks.name: Deliver to distribution
tasks.objective: Prepare compliant audio/artwork files, ingest metadata, configure territories, pricing/preorders where applicable, pitch deadlines, smart links, and quality-control checks.

tasks.name: Build launch campaign
tasks.objective: Plan announcement, singles, video/visuals, press/radio/outreach, social assets, mailing list, live or community moments, collaborators, paid media if used, and release-week sequencing.

tasks.name: Run release week
tasks.objective: Confirm platform availability and metadata, execute scheduled assets, monitor broken links/credits, coordinate collaborators, respond to press/community, and log material issues.

tasks.name: Review performance and archive
tasks.objective: Compare outcomes with goals using platform and owned-channel data, distinguish signal from vanity metrics, capture rights/asset records, reconcile spend, and document follow-up catalogue work.
